description.p: bentwire brings animated desktop characters in the formats of Microsoft Agent and the Office Assistant to the Linux Wayland desktop. A small daemon shows one character above your windows that plays its animations, speaks in a word balloon and asks questions in an Office-style balloon. Scripts, your shell and other programs drive it over D-Bus or through the bentwire command.

It ships its own characters, Wire and Quack. Original character files (Agent 2.0 ACS, ACF/ACA, Agent 1.5, Office 97 and Microsoft Bob ACT) can be converted into its open format; no Microsoft characters are included.
